title: Implement POST /api/crawl route (proxies to Express sidecar)
description: Create the Next.js API route that proxies crawl requests to the Express sidecar at http://localhost:3001/api/crawl. Needed because Crawlee can't run inside Next.js.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 503 if the Express sidecar is not reachable
Verify with curl when dev server is running

steps.details: Export POST handler. Validate url field. Forward body to `http://localhost:3001/api/crawl` using native fetch. Return the response data or error.
If fetch throws (sidecar not running), catch the error and return 503 `{ error: 'Crawl service unavailable. Make sure the sidecar is running.' }`.
Start both Next.js and Express sidecar. POST /api/crawl with a test URL. Verify the crawl response comes back through.
